order: each candidate's watch entry (name, aliases, domains, url_prefixes) written first
then the 10 questions of each category, frozen
then the candidates a frozen question names (watch's brand_in_query matcher) are out

ordinary_words.rule: a single-word name or alias is ordinary when its lowercase form, or its singular, is a lowercase headword of web2 (or a day or month name) and among the 30000 most frequent words of count_1w; names of more than one word are judged by hand (phrases)

openai_endpoint: an OpenAI-compatible endpoint given at run time (OPENAI_COMPAT_BASE_URL in place of https://openai-compatible.invalid/v1/responses; key in OPENAI_COMPAT_API_KEY); the model id is OPENAI_COMPAT_MODEL, recorded in the frozen sample
